projectDescription: A simple, open-source bilingual translation browser extension and userscript supporting multiple translation services
keyFeatures: Bilingual webpage translation with automatic text detection
Support for 15+ translation services including Google, OpenAI, DeepL, and custom APIs
YouTube subtitle translation with AI-powered sentence segmentation
Text selection translation with multi-service comparison
Input box translation via keyboard shortcuts
Hover translation for quick text previews
Custom translation rules with subscription and sharing
Cross-platform data synchronization via WebDAV or KISS-Worker
Advanced API features: streaming, context memory, batch translation
Compatible with Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and mobile browsers
publicApiSurface: toggle_styles - Switch between translation display styles
input_translate - Translate content in input fields
Custom API format - Request/response hooks for any translation service
Translation rule schema - Define custom translation rules per website
Keyboard shortcuts - Alt+Q, Alt+C, Alt+K, Alt+S, Alt+O, Alt+I
WebDAV sync - Synchronize settings and rules across devices
Rule subscription - Subscribe to community-maintained translation rules
